title: The Cap and the Cape
objectives_ko: 긴 모음 a(eɪ)와 마법 e 를 알고, 끝에 e 가 붙으면 a 가 제 이름 소리를 내는 것을 안다
cap→cape 처럼 짝 단어 4쌍을 바꿔 읽는다
a_e 단어 10개를 소리를 이어 읽고 그림과 잇고 쓴다
사이트워드 make, take를 보고 읽고, 배운 단어로 된 문장 4개를 읽는다

workbook.title: C. Read and circle.  D. Trace the sentence.

sentences.text: A snake is in the lake.
Take the tape to the gate.

story.title: The Cap and the Cape

panels.desc: The big round wooden gate of the Magic Castle, shut tight. Above it hangs a wooden sign carved with three letters c, a, p — these three letters are the ONLY text allowed in the picture — and a blue baseball cap hangs on a golden hook just below the sign. Pip hops in front of the cap with its beak open, reading it in two broken pieces, head tilted; Bun points at the cap; Hedgie scratches his head; Fairy E, the tiny glowing fairy with a star-tipped wand, hovers beside the sign giggling. Beads watches from Hedgie's flower. Beside the castle hill there is a little dark cave; a black weather vane with a rooster turns on top of a tower. Hidden in the picture: the gate, the cave, the weather vane. Grumble does NOT appear.

lines.text: Look! A cap on the gate!

panels.ko: 닫힌 대문 한가운데 파란 모자가 걸려 있어요. 핍은 "캡… 이? 캡-이!" 하고 끊어 읽어요. 요정 이가 깔깔 웃어요.

panels.desc: Fairy E taps the end of the wooden sign above the gate with her star wand: a sparkling letter e appears after the carved letters, so the sign now reads c a p e — these four letters are the ONLY text allowed in the picture. At the same moment the blue cap below swirls and stretches into a long red cape with a gold clasp, which floats down onto Bun's shoulders, and with a click the big gate swings open a little, showing warm light inside. Bun twirls in the cape, delighted; Hedgie claps; Pip stares with its beak open; Beads clicks its beads. Hidden in the picture: the red cape, the open gate, the weather vane on the tower. Grumble does NOT appear.
panels.ko: 요정 이가 별 지팡이로 간판 끝을 톡! c-a-p 끝에 반짝 e 가 붙어 cape 가 되자 모자가 빨간 망토로 바뀌어요. 대문이 살짝 열려요.

panels.desc: Inside the gate: a sunny castle courtyard with a small blue lake with little waves. On a stone table by the lake sits a round birthday cake with pink icing and three candles, next to a roll of sticky tape. A long green snake with yellow spots rises out of the lake, eyeing the cake with a sneaky grin. Hedgie points at the cake; Bun, in her red cape, points at the snake; Pip hides behind Bun's boot; Fairy E giggles. Hidden in the picture: the cake, the lake, the snake, the waves, the roll of tape. Grumble does NOT appear. No letters anywhere.

lines.text: The snake can take the cake!

panels.ko: 대문 안은 햇살 가득한 안뜰이에요. 호숫가 돌 탁자에 케이크가 있는데, 뱀이 물에서 고개를 내밀고 케이크를 노려요!

panels.desc: The snake slides away into a little dark cave with the whole cake balanced on its tail, grinning. Up on the castle wall, Grumble leans out of a high round window in his striped nightcap: Fairy E has just touched the tin can on his windowsill with her star wand, and it has turned into a wooden walking cane in his paw — he blinks at it, grumpy and surprised. A weather vane with a little rooster spins on the tower roof above him. Bun and Hedgie laugh below; Pip calls up to the window. Hidden in the picture: the cave, the cane, the weather vane, the snake, the cake. No letters anywhere.
panels.ko: 뱀이 케이크를 꼬리에 얹고 동굴로 쏙! 탑 창문에 있던 그럼블의 깡통은 요정 이 지팡이에 닿아 지팡이(cane)로 바뀌었어요. 핍은 또 "캔-이!"

story.synopsis_ko: 성 대문에 파란 모자가 걸려 있어요. 핍은 "캡-이!" 하고 끊어 읽어요. 요정 이가 지팡이로 톡! 하자 모자가 망토로 바뀌고 대문이 열려요. 안뜰 호숫가에서는 뱀이 케이크를 가져가고, 탑 창문 그럼블의 깡통은 지팡이로 바뀌어요.
story.so_far_ko: 친구들이 마법 성에 닿아 요정 이를 만났어요. 대문은 꼭 닫혀 있었어요.
story.goal_ko: 마법 e 로 짧은 a 단어를 긴 a 단어로 바꿔 읽고 대문을 열어요.

videos.prompt: Gentle comic picture-book animation: the blue cap on the gate swings on its hook, the baby bird tilts its head left and right, puzzled, the tiny glowing fairy giggles and twirls around the cap leaving twinkles, the rabbit points. Camera still. Playful, child-friendly. No text.

Gentle picture-book animation: the tiny fairy taps the cap with her star wand, sparkles burst, the cap swirls and stretches into a long red cape that floats down onto the rabbit's shoulders, the big wooden gate swings open with warm light. Camera still. Magical, child-friendly. No text.
